name: Sticky Pull Request Comment
description: Create comment on pull request, if exists update that comment.

header.description: Header to determine if the comment is to be updated, not shown on screen. It can be used when you want to add multiple comments independently at the same time.

append.description: Indicate if new comment messages should be appended to previous comment message. Only `true` is allowed. Just skip this item when you don't need it.

recreate.description: Indicate if previous comment should be removed before creating a new comment. Only `true` is allowed. Just skip this item when you don't need it.

delete.description: delete the previously created comment. Only `true` is allowed. Just skip this item when you don't need it.

only_create.description: only create a new comment if there is no existing one, otherwise do nothing. Only `true` is allowed. Just skip this item when you don't need it. This options ha

only_update.description: only update a exist comment if there is existing one, otherwise do nothing. Only `true` is allowed. Just skip this item when you don't need it.

hide_details.description: hide summary tags in the previously created comment. Only `true` is allowed. Just skip this item when you don't need it.

hide.description: hide previously created comment. Only `true` is allowed. Just skip this item when you don't need it.

hide_and_recreate.description: Indicate if previous comment should be hide before creating a new comment. Only `true` is allowed. Just skip this item when you don't need it.

hide_classify.description: The reasons a piece of content can be reported or minimized. SPAM, ABUSE, OFF_TOPIC, OUTDATED, DUPLICATE, RESOLVED.

path.description: glob path to file(s) containing comment message

ignore_empty.description: Indicates whether to ignore missing or empty messages

skip_unchanged.description: only update or recreate if message is different from previous. Only `true` is allowed. Just skip this item when you don't need it.

follow_symbolic_links.description: Indicates whether to follow symbolic links for path

number.description: pull request number for push event

owner.description: Another repo owner, If not set, the current repo owner is used by default. Note that when you trying changing a repo, be aware that GITHUB_TOKEN should also hav

repo.description: Another repo name limited use on github enterprise. If not set, the current repo is used by default. Note that When you trying changing a repo, be aware that GI

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: The GitHub access token (e.g. secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN) used to create or update the comment. This defaults to {{ github.token }}.
